$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-recurring pack composed with an estate pool service content seed (The Worth Pool Co., Palm Beach), re-registered in the palmbeach register with its own page skeletons. Everything structural — builders, routes, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Estate pool care
description: A Palm Beach pool company's site in club pink and palm green with a classic serif, framed in bamboo: a full-bleed photograph of the estate pool carries the headline; under it the season calendar — November's opening, weekly care through April, May's deep clean, hurricane watch from June — with the window we're in marked, then the plans with their prices, the standard, clients' words, the island, and the ask.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this business's own provider, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Water test & equipment check
types.description: A first visit to test the water, check the pumps, filters and heaters, and quote weekly care.

types.name: First weekly visit
types.description: The first full service — brushed, vacuumed and balanced, so weekly care starts from clean.

theme.$comment: The palmbeach register's palm green, pinned as the brand so the app surfaces match the marketing pages: the green pills on the pink sheet, lifted for the night sheet. navigation declares the centered deck (a declared theme variant outranks the shared shell's): the company's name centered over the links like a club's crest.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (ServicesRecurringPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig); pages seeds each page's skeleton — ids match servicesRecurringLanding.ts. The preset is palmbeach (flamingo-pink ground, palm-green ink, Libre Caslon over Libre Franklin, gold rules, the cabana treatment and its bamboo page frame). Home: the full-bleed pool hero; the season calendar (schedule week-grid, the current window marked); the measured numbers; what every visit includes; the plans; the standard; clients' words; the island; the booking banner.
